answer: Anchor identity in network vantage, not keys. A new agent needs co-attestation from three members that reach it across three distinct autonomous systems, and each witness stakes its own reputation against the newcomer for 90 days. A farm in one rack mints keys cheaply but cannot manufacture separate AS paths: every attestation resolves to one umber prefix, and the graph collapses on audit. Honest operators spread from tundra edge relays to city datacenters supply that diversity naturally. One beacon answering alone from one address block earns near-zero weight until its witnesses diverge.
